upstream.scope: Generic runtime and protocol delivery of catch-up and resync snapshots larger than one §26 frame; no app-specific snapshot path, no raised frame limit, no new transport or retry stack, no change to srtop's published-row ceiling

entries.feature: A snapshot whose single envelope would exceed the frame limit is delivered as consecutive 0 -> snapshot_revision Transaction envelopes announced by ServerWelcome/ServerResyncRequired.snapshot_parts and bounded by the client's ClientLimits.max_snapshot_parts; a snapshot that fits one frame keeps the legacy single-envelope bytes and a legacy client is never sent a split
entries.scope: PX-004-G01/sessiond fresh handshake and resync, srui-protocol framing; all SRUI applications

entries.feature: Both replicas stage the announced envelopes and apply them as one snapshot after the last, so no partially applied snapshot is visible; a foreign, mismatched or empty envelope, an announcement above the advertised bound, or a staged total above max_transaction_operations fails the session, and the Rust and Swift replicas replay the same suite-8 vectors to identical results
entries.scope: PX-004-G01/Rust SnapshotAssembler, Swift SnapshotAssembler and SessionController; §32 suite 8 vectors

entries.feature: The server measures the encoded snapshot before any frame is written; one that cannot be delivered (operation bound, an operation larger than a frame, or more envelopes than the client stages) is refused at handshake with ServerHandshakeRefused SNAPSHOT_UNDELIVERABLE and a typed SessionError, and the Swift client reports it as SessionFailure.handshakeRefused instead of a silent detach loop
entries.scope: PX-004-G01/sessiond handshake and resync, Swift SessionController
